description: Demolish existing buildings. Redevelopment of site for a mixed-use development four to ten storeys in height to provide 196no. residential units (C3), light industrial workshops (Eg ii and Eg iii), office and community facility (Eg i / F2) uses and associated car and cycle parking, landscaping, highway works and associated infrastructure. AMENDED PLANS (Minor amendments to submitted scheme, including removal of a vehicular access onto Shepherds Close) (Summary).
